note: UNDOCUMENTED endpoint (not in official API catalog / manual). Verified live GET works on civil (2026-07). Holds the inelastic-hinge property DEFINITION (M-phi skeleton curve / hysteresis model) that IEHG and NLNK.IEHP_NAME reference by name. See midas-api-reference.md §10-1. READ RULE: ALL_PROP[i] is a union object; only components where COMPONENT_DIR[i]==true (6-DOF [Fx,Fy,Fz,Mx,My,Mz]) hold valid values. Inactive components serialize uninitialized memory (garbage like -1717986918 / 5.29e-315). The single key in ALL_PROP[i] maps from HYSTERESIS_MODEL[i]: ETR->ELATRI, KIN->KINEMA, TAK->TAKEDA. ALL_SUBPROP[i]=J-end (equals I-end when EXIST_IJ_PROP all false).

IEHP.description: Inelastic Hinge Property (IEHP). Defines the skeleton curve / hysteresis model for an inelastic hinge; DEFINITION (SKEL vs FIBER), HINGE_TYPE, INTERACTION_TYPE and the per-slot HYSTERESIS_MODEL[] drive which optional fields and ALL_PROP/ALL_SUBPROP sub-structs apply.

DEFINITION.description: Hinge definition method (case-insensitive). SKEL=skeleton curve, FIBER=fiber section.

HINGE_TYPE.description: Hinge type (case-insensitive). LUMP=lumped, DIST=distributed, SPR=spring, TRUSS=truss, WALL=wall.

INTERACTION_TYPE.description: Axial-moment interaction type (case-insensitive). PM/PMM enable the YLDSUR yield-surface slots (6,7).

MATERIAL_TYPE.description: Material type (case-insensitive). Forced to RC internally when HINGE_TYPE=SPR.

LOCATION.description: Hinge location along member (case-insensitive): I-end, Mid, J-end.

USEIEHCLOCATION.description: IEHC location option (case-insensitive): AUTO or USER.

USE_SHEAR_R.description: [DEFINITION=FIBER & HINGE_TYPE=WALL] Use IEHC option (0) vs user-defined (1) for shear spring location.

USE_CONS_OUTPL.description: [DEFINITION=FIBER & HINGE_TYPE=DIST] Use IEHC option vs user-defined for out-of-plane nonlinearity.

CONS_OUTPL.description: [DEFINITION=FIBER & HINGE_TYPE=DIST] Consider out-of-plane nonlinearity of fiber wall.

EXIST_IJ_PROP.description: Per-slot flag (7): true means I-end and J-end properties differ, so ALL_SUBPROP[i] holds the J-end values.

MULT_DATA.description: Multi-linear force-deformation data points (used by MULTLIN models).

COMPONENT_DIR.description: Active-component flags (6) in DOF order [Fx,Fy,Fz,Mx,My,Mz]; true means that component is nonlinear and its ALL_PROP slot holds valid data.

HYSTERESIS_MODEL.description: Hysteresis model per slot (9; slots 0-5 = DOF components, 6-8 unused/yield-surface). Case-insensitive wire codes; selects which ALL_PROP[i] key must be populated. Input note: the server emits "" (=NONE) for unused slots on GET but rejects "" on input ('Wrong Field'), so "" is not an allowed input value — send a non-empty placeholder like "KIN" for unused slots instead, and give each of slots 0-5 a matching ALL_PROP[i] prop object ({"KINEMA": {}} suffices for a placeholder).

SECTION_NUM.description: [HINGE_TYPE=DIST | (HINGE_TYPE=TRUSS & DEFINITION=FIBER)] Number of integration sections per component (6).

HINGE_LOCATION.description: [HINGE_TYPE=LUMP | (HINGE_TYPE=TRUSS & DEFINITION=SKEL)] Hinge location code per component (6).

ALL_PROP.description: Property set for the 8 component slots (0-5 are DOF components in order Fx,Fy,Fz,Mx,My,Mz; 6-7 are yield surface). Each element is an IEHP_PROP union; populate the key matching HYSTERESIS_MODEL[i].

items.description: Union of hysteresis-model property structs for one of the 8 component slots. Populate exactly the key matching HYSTERESIS_MODEL[i]: KIN->KINEMA, ORG->ORIGIN, PKO->PEAK, CLO->CLOUGH, DEG->DEGRAD, TAK/MTK/REV/ASY/TAKS->TAKEDA, TTE/MTT->TAKTET, SRCT->SRCTET, NBI->NORBIL, EBI->ELABIL, ETR->ELATRI, ETE->ELATET, SLBI/SLBT/SLBC/SLTR/SLTT/SLTC->SLIP, LIBI->LRBBIL, LITR->LRBTRI, HDRI->DMPRBR, RO/HD->ROHD, MLEL/MLPK/MLPT/MLPP->MULTLIN, AXIAL->AXIAL, BUCKL->BUCKL, FBIL/FINF/FTRI->FEMA. Slots 6 and 7 use YLDSUR when INTERACTION_TYPE is PM/PMM. Leave inactive slots as an empty object.

YLDSUR.description: Yield surface / PM-PMM interaction data (used when INTERACTION_TYPE is PM or PMM). Occupies component indices 6 and 7.

P1st.description: 1st yield surface P values, [+,-] x 11 points.

M1st.description: 1st yield surface M values, [+,-] x 11 points.

P2nd.description: 2nd yield surface P values, [+,-] x 11 points.

M2nd.description: 2nd yield surface M values, [+,-] x 11 points.
